## Vinegar and Baking Soda

You pour vinegar into a conical flask, put baking soda inside a balloon, and fix the balloon tightly on the mouth of the flask. You place the whole set-up on a digital balance and note the reading. Then you lift the balloon so that the soda falls into the vinegar. It fizzes strongly, and the balloon swells with gas.

**Predict:** What will the balance show when the fizzing stops?

options.text: Less than before, because the fizzing destroys some of the matter.
More than before, because a new gas has been added.
The same as before, because nothing entered or left the set-up.
